Maya (SRE): heads up — customer ticket #C-9623 reports a ~20% 5xx rate increase since 09:42 UTC after a staged rollout. Seeing 502/504s and gateway timeouts for hosted-inference endpoints.

Zara (Support): They hit it from eu-west1 region, sending /v1/generate calls. Attached cURL and sample body.

Zara (Support): cURL:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xx-small","input":"test","max_tokens":16}'
```

Maya (SRE): repro steps: 1) set X-Region: eu-west1 2) send concurrent 10 rps with seq len 128 3) see 502s after ~90s

Leo (Platform): rolling canary uid=rl-2026-03-prefetch toggled flag enable_outbound_proxy_prefetch=true at 09:40 UTC to 15% traffic. That flag was the only change in this rollout.

Maya (SRE): logs show proxy pool saturating and connection resets. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T09:43:12Z proxy[outbound-3] ERR dial tcp 10.2.1.5:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-17T09:43:12Z gateway svc request_id=xyz status=502 upstream_error=connect_timeout
```

Amit (Product Ops): @Leo can you pause the rollout and revert the flag to false? Customers are seeing billing-impacting 5xx.

Leo (Platform): I'm on it. Pausing rollout and initiating rollback to rl-2026-03-prefetch v0.1 -> v0.0 now.

deploy-bot: rollback job started — job_id=rb-98765. Rolling traffic from 15% -> 0% over 30s.

Zara (Support): Notified customer and asked if they can rerun their test after we confirm rollback.

Maya (SRE): After rollback to 0% at 09:46:10 UTC, 5xx rate dropped to baseline within one minute. Correlation looks strong.

Maya (SRE): Root cause hypothesis: outbound prefetch triggered a burst of connections from gateway to external proxies, causing proxy pool exhaustion and DNS/connect timeouts. Also saw a small auth token refresh spike concurrent with the canary. Need to validate.

Leo (Platform): I'll audit proxy connection limits and whether prefetch increases per-request concurrency. Also checking client auth TTL churn.

oncall-bot: incident severity set to P2. Logs retained for 72h. Refer to runbook: runbooks/link-prefetch-502.

Amit (Product Ops): Next steps: 1) block-canary flag in feature store 2) run controlled load test with prefetch disabled then instrumented enabled 3) create postmortem + customer writeup.

Zara (Support): Customer thanked us; asked for ETA on the RCA.

Maya (SRE): Updated ticket: RCA ETA EOD, will include repro script and mitigation checklist. If anyone finds urgent config leak, ping here.

Leo (Platform): FYI — I'll push a conservative connection cap in proxy pool and add a circuit-breaker for prefetch by EOD.

Maya (SRE): Closing this thread when postmortem PR is created. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
